metadata.scenario: A customer objects to a late fee on their account, insisting the payment was made on time. Category: Billing. Flags: billing_dispute.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret. How can I help you today? Hi, my name is Michael Brown. I'm calling about a bill I received. Hi, Michael! I’m happy to assist you with your billing inquiry. What seems to be the issue? I was charged a late fee, but I'm pretty sure I paid on time. I understand your concern. Let me pull up your account to clarify the details. One moment, please. Sure, take your time. Thank you for your patience. I see here that a payment was received, but it was recorded after the due date. That doesn’t sound right. I remember making my payment on time. I completely understand. Can you tell me when you made the payment? I made the payment on the 5th, which was the due date. Let me check the transaction logs for that date. Just a moment, please. Of course. I see that there was a delay in processing on our end. I’m sorry for the inconvenience. So, you're saying the payment was processed late? Yes, it appears there was an internal error. I can remove the late fee for you. Thank you! I appreciate that. Can you confirm the new total for me? Sure! After removing the late fee, your new total is now $150. Great, thanks! Also, I wanted to inquire about services for my father. He has diabetes and needs wound care and medication management. Absolutely, we can assist with that. We offer skilled nursing care that includes medication management and wound care. What are the costs for those services? Skilled nursing care is between $95 and $125 per visit, depending on the specifics. Okay, and how long do those visits typically last? Each visit typically lasts about 1 to 2 hours. That sounds reasonable. Can we set up an initial assessment? Yes, we can schedule that. I’ll have our Care Coordinator, Lisa Chen, give you a call. Perfect! Is there any other information or questions you have while I have you on the line? No, I think that covers everything. Thank you! You’re welcome, Michael. I’ll ensure Lisa reaches out to you soon. Have a great day! You too, bye! Goodbye!
